title: Howie Roseman: We aren't making major changes to how we evaluate offensive linemen in the draft

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Howie Roseman: We aren't making major changes to how we evaluate offensive linemen in the draft
sources.description: The Eagles had to make a major change on their coaching staff this offseason when offensive line coach Jeff Stoutland stepped down after 13 seasons with the team.
